LanguageData.LP_FireGiant.label: fire giant
LanguageData.LP_FireGiant.description: A giant race of molten-fire blood; the bloodline is passed on to children. Adult fire giants are 2.0 times the size of an ordinary person (the bloodline body size cap), with tougher body parts but slow movement. They are completely immune to fire, can't be ignited, are extremely heat-tolerant but somewhat afraid of cold. Fire giants love crafting by nature, and items they make have better quality; they don't care about nudity and can wear ordinary clothes and ordinary armor. In the giant ordning, fire giants rank above frost giants and are their sworn enemies.
LanguageData.LP_FireGiant.descriptionShort: Inheritable molten giant race. Tall and tough, slow, fully fire-immune, fears cold, skilled crafters with better quality output, doesn't care about nudity, can wear ordinary clothes.
